name: NURS 5590
title: Adv. Pharmacodynamics and Implications for Nursing Actions Adult Gerontology Acute Care Population
description: Emphasis is placed on advanced principles of pharmacodynamics, pharmacotherapeutics, and pharmacologic management for the adult gerontology acute care population as appropriate for the acute care provider role and scope of practice.
requirement_description: NURS 5060; Instructor consent; Open only to Post-Graduate APRN Certificate, MS, and BS-DNP students in the Adult Gerontology Acute Care program.
